description:
#Illuminate the Harbor Fireworks Cruise aboard Schooner Adirondack

What better way to celebrate the end of summer, but with a stellar fireworks display from the waters of Boston Harbor? Join us aboard the historic and beautiful *Adirondack* for Illuminate the Harbor Fireworks hosted by Boston Harbor Now. This 1.5 hour cruise offers guests the opportunity to soak up Boston’s colorful fireworks display from an elegant and relaxing vantage point out on the water. The Adirondack IV is a brilliant 88-foot long pilot schooner modeled after similar boats built in the 1890s. Unlike those older boats, it is built to provide ample space to accommodate each and every one of its guests, ensuring a comfortable and quality experience for anyone who boards.
what_is_included:
- Check out the evening lighting of the Bunker Hill Monument and Old Ironsides, also known as the USS Constitution in the Charleston Navy Yard
- Enjoy the lighting on the iconic buildings and bridges of Boston Harbor such as: International Place, the arch at the Boston Harbor Hotel, the Marriott Custom House Tower, New England Aquarium, The Leonard P. Zakim Bridge, and The Mystic Tobin Bridge.
- Delicious, complimentary desserts and sliced fruits.
- The best view of the Labor Day fireworks show out on the Boston Harbor
- Within minutes of leaving the dock, you'll forget the distractions of life on land as you experience the joy of a leisurely night. In addition, you will get views of Boston’s Skyline and the fireworks display that cannot be matched anywhere else!

what_is_not_included:
- The price of drinks is not included in the cost of your ticket, so please bring a credit card to purchase on board. Credit Cards are the only form of payment accepted on your cruise. Please plan accordingly. Soda & Water is $2.00, beer is $6.00, wine is $7.00/glass, and mixed drinks are $9.00.
- Gratuity is not included in the price of your sail.

highlights:
**Please note that we may not be able to raise sail for the fireworks due to crowding in the harbor. If time permits, we may do some sailing before the fireworks.** 

***Come join us as we celebrate Labor Day!***

- Please note that the fireworks are weather permitting.

Your knowledgeable captain and crew are always ready to answer your questions about the sights and history of Boston Harbor and its surrounding areas. From interesting facts to old-time legends, the maritime world of Boston has many great stories to offer. Ask them anything you'd like to know!

#About Adirondack III

Inspired by the pilot schooners of the 1890’s, Classic Harbor Line’s Adirondack III is 80-ft in length, features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, complete with 2 bathrooms, and just under 2,000 square feet of canvas to escort you through Boston’s historic harbor!
Though it is a light and lively sailing vessel, it is also quite comfortable, with ample deck space and seating for up to 41. It was designed and built by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures.
Sailing in this schooner is a delight. She moves through the water efficiently and beautifully; we take great pride in sharing her with you.
The Adirondack III is operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and an extremely friendly and talented crew. Our crew is known for their amazing hospitality, and are professionally trained and experienced in sailing our vessels well and safely. Do not hesitate to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites.
